section_summary.extract_value: This section details the procedure for a study where undergraduate students were recruited and completed three questionnaires via Qualtrics online survey platform. It also describes a rigorous 5-step process for translating the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2) from English to Arabic. Table 1 provides the items of the BAS-2 in both languages, along with descriptive statistics and item-factor loadings for the complete sample of 256 participants.
